speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe the exact moment you lost consciousness, including any warning symptoms, how long you were out, and your condition upon waking.

speaker: Patient
text: 53-year-old male. The patient was brought to the emergency department after an episode of loss of consciousness that occurred 1 hour ago, immediately after micturating. His wife found him unconscious on the bathroom floor. He regained consciousness after about 30 seconds without any confusion or amnesia for the event. No history of urinary incontinence during the event.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Commotio Cordis (Micturition Syncope). Given the specific timing of the syncope immediately following urination, a rapid fall, and immediate recovery without confusion, this is most consistent with micturition syncope rather than commotio cordis. I will proceed with a focused workup to rule out other causes. REQUEST TEST: ECG; REQUEST TEST: Electrolytes; REQUEST TEST: Glucose.
